text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen. First, you need to find the risks that could affect your project or business. These might include money problems, bad weather, or losing important workers. After identifying risks, you create mitigation strategies to reduce their impact. For example, you can buy insurance or train extra staff. You should also make contingency plans, which are backup ideas in case something goes wrong. Finally, monitoring is essential. You must watch the situation regularly and update your plans when needed. Good risk management helps you avoid surprises and protects your goals.
